title: Crimsonite
description: Crimsonite is a resource pack that changes the look of Netherite to be a nice looking rose color!
body:
A full retexture of Netherite gear in Minecraft Java Edition, replacing the default dark metal look with a sleek, rose-colored aesthetic. This elegant redesign keeps all stats and item names the same — just with a fresh, bold look that stands out in every dimension.

Whether you're battling in full gear or showing off your enchanted tools, Crimsonite gives your Netherite a refined, mystical glow that sets it apart from the vanilla grind.

Made and used by catwizardlmao, me!

![Little bit of what i had done at the time of making this!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/448238ad80078dc933e981fb3ae46d8ac121a3c7.png)

✔️ _Features:_

All Netherite armor, tools, and weapons retextured in a rose-metal style

Custom Netherite Ingot and Scrap with matching rose tones

New Ancient Debris block to match the set

Includes full in-world armor model retextures

Vanilla-friendly — all item names, stats, and recipes remain unchanged

Compatible with any server or modpack that uses base Netherite.
